Executive summary:  Welltower Inc. (NYSE: WELL) is an S&P 500 real-estate investment trust (REIT) headquartered in Toledo, Ohio, that invests with leading seniors-housing operators, post-acute providers and health systems to fund the real-estate and infrastructure needed to scale innovative care-delivery models.  The company owns interests in properties concentrated in major, high-growth markets in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.  These assets consist of seniors-housing communities, post-acute communities and outpatient-medical properties.  Welltower’s capital programs, combined with comprehensive planning, development and property-management services, allow it to act as a single-source solution for acquiring, planning, developing, managing, repositioning and monetizing health-care real-estate assets.  Substantially all revenues are derived from operating-lease rentals, resident fees/services and interest on outstanding loans receivable.  The company’s stated objectives are to protect shareholder capital, enhance shareholder value, pay consistent cash dividends and create opportunities to increase dividend payments through annual NOI growth and portfolio expansion.

A detailed table (not shown here) summarises the 2017 consolidated portfolio by property type, including each category’s net operating income (NOI), its percentage of total NOI and the number of properties.

Tools you can call:
• list_property_categories() → list of {id, name} dictionaries for every property category in the database.
• get_property_category_id(category_name: str) → integer id for a given category name (case-insensitive) or None.
• count_properties_by_category_id(category_id: int) → integer count of properties that belong to the specified category id.
• sum_integers(values: List[int]) → integer sum of all numbers in *values*.
• get_financial_summary(category_name: str, fiscal_year: int) → dict containing the NOI for the requested category and year.
• list_tenants_with_rating(rating: str) → list of tenant names that have the given credit rating.
All database access must be performed through these tools.
